links.outcome: Consistency of LLM risk stratification across repeated evaluations
links.effect: Gemini, GPT-4, and R1 showed highest consistency across repeated evaluations; Llama showed greater variability that improved with added context.

links.outcome: Calibration of LLM mortality risk categories versus APACHE II predictions
links.effect: LLMs overestimated risk, classifying more patients as high risk than APACHE II; mortality in high-risk groups was lower than APACHE-predicted rates, indicating calibration mismatch.
links.quote: Mortality rates within high-risk groups were lower than APACHE-predicted rates, suggesting calibration mismatch.

links.outcome: LLM mortality risk stratification compared with APACHE II
links.effect: LLMs classified more patients as high risk than APACHE II, with calibration mismatch; Gemini with added context uniquely identified a low-risk group.
